title: Shadow's Custom Cobblemon Pack
description: This mod adds 5 custom gym badges for the server I play on.
body:
This mod adds 5 badges that me and my friends can use in our server. This mod was made fully for our server but feel free to download and check it out. The badges were made between us so they do vary in detail.

Badges include:

Venomheart Valor = Fighting, Fairy and Poison badge (designed by ShadowKnight666).
Halocharge = Normal, Electric, Flying (designed by Potato_Engineer).
Pyrocore = Fire, Rock, Ground (designed by KermitTheFrog).
Eclipseshade Sigil = Psychic, Dark, Ghost (designed by Sensei).
Frostscale = Ice, Steel, Dragon (designed by ShadowKnight666).


There will be more coming to this mod soon, with the badges being able to give you effects when held in the offhand.
